import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List all source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_61/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_61/test_1.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_61/test_2.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_61/test_3.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_61/test_4.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_61/test_5.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_61/test_6.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_61/test_7.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_61/test_8.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_61/test_9.csv"
    ]

    # Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
    dfs = []
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path, dtype={'start': str, 'betterliving': 'Int64'})
        # Ensure columns are exactly as target schema
        df = df[['start', 'betterliving']]
        dfs.append(df)

    # Concatenate all source DataFrames vertically (union)
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # The target schema is ['start': string, 'betterliving': integer]
    # Convert 'start' to string explicitly (dates are strings in source)
    combined_df['start'] = combined_df['start'].astype(str)

    # Convert 'betterliving' to integer type, handling missing values if any
    # Using pandas nullable integer type Int64 to allow NA if present
    combined_df['betterliving'] = combined_df['betterliving'].astype('Int64')

    # Since all sources have the same schema and data type, and the target examples
    # show no aggregation or join needed, the transformation is a simple union.

    # Optional: Remove duplicates if any (not specified but often useful)
    combined_df = combined_df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)

    # Save the combined DataFrame to the target CSV file
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_61/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    combined_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
